title: Densities transfer under ball-mass scaling
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, let μ, ν be measures on ℝ^N (Euclidean N), y, z ∈ ℝ^N, t > 0, δ > 0, c ∈ [0,∞] with c ≠ ∞, and θ ∈ [0,∞]. Suppose that for every ρ with 0 < ρ < δ, ν(B_ρ(y)) = c·(ofReal((t⁻¹)^n)·μ(B_{tρ}(z))) (closed balls, arithmetic in ℝ≥0∞), and that HasDensity n μ z θ, i.e. densityRatio n μ z ρ = μ(B_ρ(z))/(ω_n·ofReal(ρ)^n) → θ as ρ ↓ 0. Then HasDensity n ν y (c·θ).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclidean N)) (y z : Euclidean N) (t δ : ℝ) (c θ : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < t → 0 < δ → c ≠ ∞ → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → ν (closedBall y ρ) = c * (ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n) * μ (closedBall z (t * ρ)))) → HasDensity n μ z θ → HasDensity n ν y (c * θ)
